windows.primary_metric: cycle_time_s: mean time per completed full ground lap (window-independent; needs >= 2 lap completions in the run)
windows.equal_window_metric: worst_revisit_ground_eqwin_s: longest unserviced interval of any ground checkpoint within [0, 300] s, every condition incl. the guard, from the run's own per-step service times (patrol_metrics.worst_revisit_window)
windows.unequal_window_columns: worst_revisit_ground_s, mean_revisit_ground_s, worst_revisit_gallery_s, n_ground_laps are over each run's own duration (guard and UAV windows differ); never compare them across conditions as primary

mean_wind_nominal_mps: ASSUMPTION: 0-6 m/s outdoor mean wind; x wind_scale 0.08 indoors
gust_sigma_nominal_mps: ASSUMPTION: 0.5-2.0 m/s OU gust intensity; x wind_scale
intruder_appear_s: design: intruder enters after the patrol is established
dock_jitter_m: ASSUMPTION: 0-0.3 m landing placement error on the dock

mean_wind_nominal_mps: ASSUMPTION: 0-6 m/s mean wind at 20-40 m AGL
intruder_appear_s: design: intruder enters after the patrol is established
dock_jitter_m: ASSUMPTION: 0-0.3 m landing placement error on the dock

walk_speed_mps: Bohannon RW, Age Ageing 1997;26(1):15-19, doi 10.1093/ageing/26.1.15: comfortable gait speed, strata means 1.272-1.462 m/s (adults 20-79). A patrolling guard may walk slower; using comfortable gait is the conservative choice (it favours the guard baseline). Drawn per seed
stop_mean_s: ASSUMPTION: 10-60 s mean pause per checkpoint (tag scan, look around); no primary source found (sources_verified.md L-24). Drawn per seed
stop_spread: ASSUMPTION: each pause ~ U[(1 - 0.5) mean, (1 + 0.5) mean], drawn per checkpoint
eye_height_m: ASSUMPTION: 1.5-1.7 m adult eye height; telemetry z is the eye point
transfer_xy: in front of the lift doors (y = -32.0 m, lift lobby x in [-6, 6]) in build_nmims_interior.py; a stair beside the lift core is ASSUMED (not modelled)
stair_vertical_mps: ASSUMPTION: 0.25-0.40 m/s vertical progress climbing stairs, drawn per seed. Anchors (sources_verified.md L-24): stair ascent 0.65 (sd 0.1) m/s slope-wise, Dostan et al., PLoS One 2023, doi 10.1371/journal.pone.0283333; about 0.52 m/s horizontal from 107.4 steps/min x 0.29 m going, Sun et al., Front Public Health 2026, doi 10.3389/fpubh.2025.1725056. Vertical = 0.5-0.65 m/s x sin(30-35 deg) = 0.25-0.37 m/s for an ASSUMED 30-35 deg stair pitch (the stair is not modelled)
lift_wait_s: ASSUMPTION: 15-60 s waiting for a lift, drawn per descent
detect_radius_m: ASSUMPTION: 10-20 m at which a guard notices a person in an unlit/lit corridor
translucent_alpha: design: geoms with alpha below this do not block the guard's view
body_half_width_m: ASSUMPTION: 0.25-0.35 m half shoulder width (walking-leg clearance rays)
leg_ray_heights_m: design: knee, waist and eye height above the walking floor
detour_step_m: design: sideways step tried when a walking leg is blocked
detour_max_m: design: largest sideways shift tried before giving up (error)
guards_per_round: ASSUMPTION: 1-2 guards per round (no primary source, sources_verified.md L-24); the simulation walks ONE guard

definitions.n_laps_alpha, n_laps_bravo, n_laps_guard: completed passes of each agent's own route (guard: completed ground cycles)
definitions.min_inter_uav_m: min centre distance once both UAVs have left the takeoff phase
definitions.detected, detection_latency_s, verify_ti: UAV: DualUAVSurveillanceController.surveillance_metrics (FSM incidents, true detection = verify fix within MATCH_M of the intruder); guard: foot_patrol_baseline line of sight
